user.title: Kohler Anthem setup — credentials
user.description: Enter the API credentials extracted from the Kohler Konnect app. See [setup docs]({docs_url}) for instructions. After this step you'll be asked to sign in via your browser.

authorize.title: Kohler Anthem setup — sign in
authorize.description:
Open this URL in any browser and sign in:

[Sign in to Kohler]({authorize_url})

After signing in, your browser will try to open `{redirect_uri}` (a custom URL the official mobile app uses). The browser won't be able to follow it — it'll show an error page or a 'Open in app?' prompt. **Copy the full URL** (it should contain `?code=...&state=...`) and paste it below.

data_description.redirect_url: The full URL your browser ends up at after signing in (starts with `msauth.com.kohler.hermoth://auth?code=...`).

reauth_confirm.title: Kohler Anthem — sign in again
reauth_confirm.description:
Your refresh token has expired or been revoked. Open this URL in any browser and sign in:

[Sign in to Kohler]({authorize_url})

After signing in, paste the full redirect URL below.

error.invalid_redirect: That URL didn't include `code` and `state`. Make sure you copied the entire address bar contents.
error.state_mismatch: Security check failed (`state` mismatch). Restart the flow and sign in again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Kohler token endpoint. Check your network.

abort.cannot_discover: Sign-in succeeded but device discovery failed. Check the APIM key and API resource.
abort.manual_oauth_required: Kohler now requires interactive sign-in. Please add the integration via the UI — YAML configuration is no longer supported.
abort.missing_tenant_id: The signed-in token did not contain a tenant id (`oid`/`sub`). This shouldn't happen — please open an issue.
abort.reauth_unknown_entry: Reauth flow could not find the original config entry.
